title: Recap: Swap the Variable
text: Sign a pattern is right is that using it again is boring. Your turn. Look at the last few things you built, and ask Claude to find the one shape hiding inside them. Then ask what single variable you'd swap to get the next one for free. If reusing it feels boring, you built the pattern right. Run this and go find your swap. Swap the variable.
